response.sql: SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance) AS attendance_share FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position ORDER BY attendance_share DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Share is a fraction (0 to 1) of all rows in the attendance table, including any attendance rows whose member id has no matching member. It is not a percentage.
Ties in share are broken arbitrarily, because the request gives no tie-break rule.

alternatives.interpretation: Share is the member's attendance divided by attendance from members who exist in the member table, so orphaned attendance rows are excluded from the total.
alternatives.sql: SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS attendance_share FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position ORDER BY attendance_share DESC LIMIT 10
